description: Fill form fields in a PDF by name. Supports text fields, checkboxes ("true"/"false"), dropdowns, option lists, and radio groups. Field names must match the form exactly; reading the form first lists them with their types. Optionally flattens the form to make it non-editable. Encrypted PDFs are not supported and return an error.

fields.description: Object mapping field names to values. For checkboxes: "true" or "false". For dropdowns/radio: the option value string.

filePath.description: Path to the PDF file with form fields

flatten.description: If true, flattens the form making fields non-editable (default: false)

outputPath.description: Path where the filled PDF will be saved

name: pdf_form_fill
